status: Available style specification; final outputs require format-specific visual checks
source: Original interpretations of style names demonstrated in a user-supplied video; not recovered source code.
quality_checks: Readable text and measured contrast against rendered colors
No information communicated by color alone
Responsive layout with no horizontal overflow
Content remains readable without blur or animation

motion.reduced_motion: Remove decorative movement and nonessential transitions

name: Art deco
summary: Architectural rhythm and gold detail with quiet elegance.
use_when: Use for premium event pages, leadership communication, and milestone presentations.
avoid_when: Use sparingly in dense reading and preserve stable, high-contrast text surfaces.
typography: Georgia serif headings with widely spaced short labels.
layout: Symmetrical alignment, vertical rhythm, and restrained ornamental framing.
surfaces: Deep navy, thin gold rules, and stepped geometric corners.

adaptations.web: Use the tokens and live components; validate keyboard, mobile, contrast, and reduced motion.
adaptations.slides: Preserve hierarchy and palette with native editable shapes and text. Replace motion with static emphasis.
adaptations.documents: Use native headings, readable body text, restrained callouts, and solid reading surfaces.
adaptations.images: Describe composition and material cues; check text and layout separately. Do not claim pixel-exact token fidelity.

prompt: Apply Art deco to [DELIVERABLE] for [AUDIENCE]. Purpose: [GOAL]. Preserve all supplied content, existing visuals, and required brand constraints. Georgia serif headings with widely spaced short labels. Symmetrical alignment, vertical rhythm, and restrained ornamental framing. Deep navy, thin gold rules, and stepped geometric corners. Palette: background #111d2d, surface #192a3b, text #fbf2db, muted #d4c6a3, accent #e3c789, border #8e7d56. Essential traits: Stepped ornamental border; Gold-on-navy contrast; Symmetrical composition. Avoid: Thin gold body text; Ornament behind reading text; Decorative fonts at small sizes. Keep motion restrained and optional, respect reduced motion, and provide a static fallback. Adapt the appearance to the requested output format. Keep text legible, controls accessible, and content editable where supported. Resolve mandatory brand conflicts explicitly. Return the design and accurately report performed and unperformed checks.
